newsitem.title: GHANA: Few buyers for Ghana shares, record trading low.
newsitem.headline: Few buyers for Ghana shares, record trading low.

text.p: Lack of buyers on Monday depressed Ghana's Stock Exchange, which notched up a record trading low.
With just 2,600 shares traded, the All-Share Index slipped 0.15 points to 357.14 points, the GSE market report showed.
Offers of 2,554,150 compared with bids of just 338,500.
Aluworks, up five cedis to 1,415 cedis, and Mechanical Lloyd Co up one to 56 cedis, were the only risers. Unilever down five to 760 cedis was the only loser.
"It (the market) is starved of buyers and no-one is ready to sell below the present prices listed," one dealer said.
